integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, cinematic anime style with high-contrast lighting, a tight close-up of the same young pink-haired woman's face in mid-action, her brow deeply furrowed, mouth open mid-yell, eyes fierce and locked forward, dust smudges already on her cheek. The camera holds a static shot as she leans forward with intent.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.400, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of the same woman's hand slamming down hard on a circular green button set in a worn metal console, the strike forceful and immediate. The camera shakes strongly as the metal console creaks.

[Shot 3] At 00:00.800, the shot cuts to the same extreme close-up as a jagged blue electrical arc leaps violently upward from the button surface, the arc surging twice its previous height. The camera holds a static shot as the arc continues into the next shot.

[Shot 4] At 00:01.200, the shot cuts to the same extreme close-up continuing the previous frame's upward arc as the blue arc dies at the top of its travel and immediately reignites twice in rapid succession, the bright blue flashes strobing across the metal surface. The camera shakes slightly.

[Shot 5] At 00:01.550, the shot cuts to a POV tracking shot at fast speed rushing forward through a dim corridor in the same screen-right direction the woman was facing, dust particles streaking past the lens. The camera shakes strongly as the floor tilts into a slight Dutch angle.

[Shot 6] At 00:01.900, the shot cuts to a low-angle full shot matching the corridor's forward motion, revealing the same pink-haired woman with pointed ears and a flowing red cape sprinting forward down an empty street, her closed white umbrella extended like a lance in the same screen-right direction. The camera tracks at fast speed alongside her.

[Shot 7] At 00:02.250, the shot cuts to a tight close-up of the same woman's face matching her sprinting speed, her jaw tight, eyes burning forward. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed as her red cape snaps at the frame edge.

[Shot 8] At 00:02.600, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of the same woman's hand gripping the umbrella shaft, matching the forward thrust. The camera pushes in at fast speed as foreshortened fingers and the white canopy rim thrust toward the lens in the same screen-right direction, the motion continuing into the next shot.

[Shot 9] At 00:02.950, the shot cuts to a pure white flash frame continuing Shot 8's forward thrust at the exact moment of impact, the entire frame overexposed to maximum brightness with a faint yellow ring at center.

[Shot 10] At 00:03.300, the shot cuts to a wide shot of dark debris fanning outward radially from the central impact point in the same screen-right direction. The camera pulls out at fast speed as orange-red light bleeds between the spinning fragments.

[Shot 11] At 00:03.650, the camera cuts to a medium shot beginning a parallel cross-cut: the same pink-haired woman tumbling backward through the air against an orange-red sky, her red cape flaring outward in the same direction as the debris from Shot 10. The camera holds a static shot.

[Shot 12] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts back to the same woman mid-tumble, the same momentum carrying her as her umbrella spins away from her open hand into the debris field. The camera pans right with small amplitude at fast speed following the umbrella.

[Shot 13] At 00:04.350, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up of the same woman's boot striking pavement, continuing her impact from above. The camera shakes strongly as dust kicks up violently.

[Shot 14] At 00:04.700, the shot cuts to a wide shot of a damaged street sign post passing the lens at speed in the same screen-right direction, the post blurring and exiting frame. The camera trucks right at fast speed.

[Shot 15] At 00:05.050, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of red energy bursts cracking across a black metal surface in the same orange-red palette as the previous cross-cut sequence. The camera shakes strongly as the cracks branch like lightning and embers scatter.

[Shot 16] At 00:05.400, the shot cuts to a close-up of a single ember scattering across the dark surface, leaving a tiny orange trail continuing the energy burst's direction. The camera holds a static shot as the ember fades.

[Shot 17] At 00:05.750, the camera cuts to a low-angle full shot of a giant golden ring summoning above a crowd of dark silhouettes, the warm gold palette taking over. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed as white geometric symbols drift upward from the ring's center.

[Shot 18] At 00:06.100, the shot cuts to a wide tracking shot at fast speed of the same crowd of dark silhouettes rushing forward in the same screen-right direction, their outlines blurring with motion. The camera trucks right.

[Shot 19] At 00:06.450, the shot cuts to a wide tracking shot at fast speed of a flock of crows streaking across an orange-red dusk sky in the same screen-right direction, matching the running crowd's motion vector. The camera pans right.

[Shot 20] At 00:06.800, the shot cuts to the same framing as the crow silhouettes converge into a single black mass that sweeps past the lens and blackens the frame. The camera holds the pan, the darkness transitioning into the next shot.

[Shot 21] At 00:07.150, the shot cuts to a close-up of a yellow chevron-patterned capsule container emerging from the previous frame's darkness, twin electrical arcs dancing along its top edge in the same warm gold palette as the ring. The camera holds a static shot as both arcs leap high and explode outward.

[Shot 22] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of a golden-yellow energy field beginning to expand outward from the capsule's position, the same warm gold palette continuing. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as the field's edge overtakes nearby architecture.

[Shot 23] At 00:07.850, the shot cuts to a wide shot continuing the previous energy field as its brightness overtakes the silhouettes inside it, inverting the frame into a near-white negative image. The camera continues pulling out.

[Shot 24] At 00:08.200, the shot cuts to a frame-inversion effect as the entire screen flips into a near-white negative, the camera holds a static shot as only the dark outlines of buildings remain visible against the white void, the negative image continuing into the next shot's composition.

[Shot 25] At 00:08.550, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of the same pink-haired woman's face matching the high-contrast composition of Shot 24, the same warm-orange rim light on her jaw. The camera pushes in at fast speed as her purple eyes widen, her brow furrows, and dust smudges intensify on her cheek.

[Shot 26] At 00:09.050, the shot cuts to the same extreme close-up as she opens her mouth in a fierce scream, the audio beginning here and continuing across the cut into the next shot. The camera holds a static shot as red ink-like brushstrokes burst outward from her lips forming a calligraphic flash character "雷" filling the frame.

[Shot 27] At 00:09.500, the shot cuts to the same framing continuing Shot 26's scream audio as the "雷" character reaches full size and a sharp orange-red rim light cuts across her jaw. The camera holds a static shot.

[Shot 28] At 00:09.950, the shot cuts to a high-angle overhead shot, matching the radial expansion of the "雷" character strokes as a small figure at the center of a dark crater is engulfed by a rising column of orange-yellow light. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 29] At 00:10.400, the shot cuts to the same high-angle framing as the blast collapses inward, continuing the radial pattern from Shot 28. The camera holds a static shot as the column shrinks and the figure begins to rise against the collapsing energy.

[Shot 30] At 00:10.900, the shot cuts to a low-angle shot of the same pink-haired woman rising from the blast crater, a new golden energy aura igniting around her body, her red cape snapping upward in the same screen-right direction as the original charge. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed tracking her ascent.

[Shot 31] At 00:11.400, the shot cuts to the same low-angle framing as two massive wings of golden-yellow energy unfurl from her back, the wing tips reaching the edges of the frame. The camera continues tilting up at fast speed.

[Shot 32] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide shot of the same woman launching straight up into the sky, her energy wings fully extended, a long trail of golden-yellow fire streaking downward behind her boots. The camera tilts up at fast speed following her trajectory.

[Shot 33] At 00:12.600, the shot cuts to an extreme wide shot looking straight up at the sky, dozens of jagged electric-blue lightning bolts converging on the same woman from every direction as she ascends through them. The camera holds a static shot.

[Shot 34] At 00:13.200, the shot cuts to the same upward framing as the lightning bolts simultaneously strike the same woman at center frame, the impact points creating bright white-blue explosions along her body. The camera holds a static shot.

[Shot 35] At 00:13.800, the shot cuts to the same upward framing as the same woman thrusts both hands outward, redirecting the absorbed lightning back in every direction, the redirected bolts exploding outward from her body. The camera holds a static shot as the radial pattern mirrors the earlier "雷" character.

[Shot 36] At 00:14.400, the shot cuts to an extreme wide shot of a massive radial lightning explosion, electric-blue and white bolts fanning outward in every direction from the same woman's position at center, filling the entire frame with expanding energy that does not recede before the cut. The camera holds a static shot as the screen reaches peak brightness at the moment of cut.

overall_soundscape: A heavy footfall rhythm on pavement from the very first frame, layered with the sharp buzz of electrical arcs and the snap of fabric. A sharp metallic impact cuts through the sound bed, followed by a rising roar of expanding energy and a fierce scream, all building toward a sustained crackling discharge of massed lightning bolts.

non_diegetic_music: Driving electronic percussion at a fast tempo layered with deep sub-bass pulses and sharp hi-hat patterns, joined by swelling brass stabs, distorted synths, and a choral chant that peaks with each new escalation wave, sustaining through the final radial explosion without resolving.
